Archangel Rawful workspace

A fictional ethical framework and local records prototype. It grants no supernatural, political, legal, or clinical authority. Entries are not saved after reload; exported records are unencrypted. Do not enter passwords, tokens, or private health information.

Pause and find support

This panel is optional and does not diagnose, prescribe medication, or contact anyone. If you are in immediate danger, may hurt yourself or someone else, or have severe symptoms that could be a medical emergency, contact your local emergency service or ask someone nearby for help.

If useful, notice a few objects around you and feel the support of the chair or ground. Choose a comfortable place if possible. Skip anything that makes you feel worse.

For ongoing or recurring distress, consider an appropriate healthcare professional. This page has no verified local emergency-number database.

Copyleft republication checklist

  • Keep required notices and mark modifications.
  • Check source-availability obligations and third-party assets.
  • Review unclear requirements before redistributing.
